facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: Valuation-based; can match qualifying prior round
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 至少一位 founder 与 Australia/New Zealand 有联系；至少一位 cofounder full-time；不是 agency/services/charity/lifestyle business；需 venture-scale。

facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 高增长科技创业；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。

facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Valuation-based; can match qualifying prior round
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: At least one founder connected to Australia or New Zealand and at least one full-time cofounder. Venture-scale businesses only, excluding agencies, services, charities and lifestyle businesses.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Distinctive founder strengths, customer insight, ambition, a clear problem and solution, and an authentic 90-second pitch.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Hybrid participation from Australia or New Zealand, with three in-person weeks for kickoff, midpoint and Demo Day; the remainder is remote.
facts.International Founder: Not a general global program — requires ANZ connection
facts.Visa / Relocation: Generally centered on Australia and New Zealand; international founders must meet ANZ-connection and participation requirements.
facts.Application Materials: Written application and a 90-second video, followed by an approximately one-hour remote interview.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: High-growth technology startups; primarily at the Pre-seed–seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration
